text: Core courses Basic French, Extensive French Reading, French Listening, French Speaking, French Writing, Advanced French, Tourism French, Secretary French, Business French, A Survey of France Objective This objective is to train students to meet the development of the 21th century social politics, economy, culture and science and technology. After graduation, students will be able to work as multi-competent and applied-oriented English language personnel in the fields of teaching, international trade and economics, foreign affairs, tourism, culture, journalism or scientific research. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted
